stories.title: Davidovich Fokina Stuns No. 1 Zverev to Reach First Masters 1000 Final in Shanghai

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: ALEJANDRO DAVIDOVICH FOKINA BEATS ALEXANDER ZVEREV. The No. 26 stuns the World No. 1, 5-7, 6-4, 6-3. Fokina is in the Shanghai Masters final. Zverev — tournament favorite — is going home. #ShanghaiMasters #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Fokina vs. Zverev in Shanghai: 36 winners vs. 28. 3 points lost on serve in the third set. He's back in the ATP Top 15 and he has a Masters 1000 final waiting on Sunday. #ShanghaiMasters #Tennis

stories.title: Kartal Beats Ostapenko in Back-to-Back Tiebreaks to Reach First WTA 1000 Final

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: SONAY KARTAL IS IN THE WUHAN FINAL. No. 170 in the world def. Ostapenko 7-6(11), 7-6(5). Won by ONE point in total (88-87). Six months out injured. Now in the biggest final of her career. #WuhanOpen #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Kartal's week: beat Svitolina (No. 6), beat Ostapenko (No. 34), did it all from a wildcard slot after six months off with a back injury. She faces either Swiatek or Chwalinska on Sunday. #WuhanOpen #Tennis

stories.title: Medvedev Into Shanghai Final — Sixth Consecutive Year Reaching Title Match

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: Daniil Medvedev is in the Shanghai Masters final for the sixth year in a row. Nobody else has done that. He beat Rafael Jodar in the semis and meets Fokina on Sunday. #ShanghaiMasters #Tennis
